title: agents(os-dev), pm(references): carry the E3 standard and its three ruled boundaries
body:
Fixes #15905

The maintainer's E3 standard (2026-09-05, verbatim: 「已发布必修,其余立卡」 — a defect on a published surface is repaired in the round; non-published residue is carded and the PR lands) and the three boundaries the director seat recorded on the card (comment 5564373328, decision batch #64, maintainer reply verbatim 「同意」) had no carrier in the agent corpus. This PR writes them once, rules-only, in the house style: one rule per line, at most 120 bytes, plain language, no provenance, no issue numbers or comment ids in the corpus. Four lines in total, each paid by a fold under an unchanged ratchet pin. Governed surface (`.claude/**`): draft, human merge.

## Step 1 — carrier measurement (no carrier)

At `origin/main` = `00d54940eb`, `grep -rn` over `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`:

| term | hits |
|---|---|
| `已发布必修` | 0 (exit 1) |
| `其余立卡` | 0 (exit 1) |
| `E3` | 0 (exit 1) |
| `published surface` | 0 (exit 1) |
| `dist/**/*.d.ts` | 0 (exit 1) |
| `sourcesContent` | 0 (exit 1) |
| `files[]` | 0 (exit 1) |
| `已发布` | 16 — all unrelated rows (changeset, release-blocking classes, contract-review claim, landing criteria, decision-box routing); none states the standard or a definition of published |

`core-rules.md` (150/150) is additionally excluded by its own line 3, 「本文不新增规则」 — it is a digest of SKILL.md and cannot be the first home of a rule. So the definition and the two boundaries go to `references/review-checklist.md` (77/77), beside its in-place-repair and 「`private: false` 即已发布」 review items; the obligation goes to `os-dev.md` (403/403), closing its rule-3 in-place-repair block.

## The four lines — file, neighbour, fold

| # | line (as landed) | file | neighbour it sits beside | fold that paid for it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `本轮改动令其变假或触碰的已发布缺陷必修;其余立卡并记明已发布面,PR 照常落地。` (115 B) | `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (rule 3, after 「优先扩展一个守卫关掉整个类;任一条不成立 ⇒ 回默认」) | 就地修欠两样 / 四条件 block, lines 59–62 | deleted 「返回消息是加速器,不是记录;只存在于返回消息里的报告随你的进程一起死。」 — a rationale tail under 「报告落两次,GitHub 优先」 and 「两种派发模式下 GitHub 都是报告的权威源」, both of which stay |
| 2 | `已发布 = 各包 \`files[]\` 实际发运的内容;spec 发运 \`src/**/*.zod.ts\`,假 TSDoc/\`.describe()\` 即缺陷。` (119 B) | `references/review-checklist.md`, 范围与 changeset | after 「再核 claim 文件面同轮已修订、PR 正文点名该修并载证据」, before 「`private: false` 即已发布 ⇒ …changeset」 | deleted 「否则合并静默关掉决策箱里的卡,而收件箱过滤只看 open。」 — rationale for the `Fixes`/`Part of` rule above it; the fact is kept verbatim in os-dev.md's 「⛔ 永不 `Fixes` 一张还在决策箱的卡」 line |
| 3 | `\`.js.map\` 的 \`sourcesContent\` 不算已发布:构建关闭其内嵌源码,关闭前也不计。` (98 B) | same block | directly under line 2 | deleted 「只写 `toThrow()` 或 `rejects.toThrow()` 的用例在未修实现本就抛裸 Error 的那族上恒绿。」 — rationale between the 「抽查…断言 `code` 与 `status`」 and 「缺 `code`/`status` 断言判 REWORK」 rules, both of which stay; the lesson is kept in os-dev.md's 「单独的 `expect(...).toThrow()` 不是拒收测试」 line |
| 4 | `本轮令其变假或触碰的已发布缺陷必修;只注意到、未触碰的立卡不修,记明已发布面。` (115 B) | same block | directly under line 3 | merged 「⛔ 不接受结论散文:绕过去的报告与守约的长得一样。」 into its neighbour: 「报告清掉了它被要求停下的停条件 ⇒ 亲核证据再 ACCEPT,⛔ 不接受结论散文。」 (103 B) — the ⛔ rule stays, only the rationale tail leaves |

Line 4 carries both halves of boundary 3 on the PM side so the checklist is self-contained: the positive obligation the reviewer checks (made-false-or-touched ⇒ repaired in-round) and the ruled limit (merely noticed, untouched ⇒ carded, published-surface fact on the card). Line 1 is the dev-side twin of that obligation, the same way the 就地修 four conditions already live on both sides. The wording 「构建关闭其内嵌源码,关闭前也不计」 is deliberately tense-neutral: the `sourcesContent: false` build change is a separate devx card (#16469 remains open) and the boundary does not depend on its landing.

Not written: nothing in `SKILL.md` (flight Z's file), nothing in `core-rules.md`, no ceiling raise, no new section.

## 验收备注

- noted, not filed: the dev reads the `files[]`-derived definition of 「已发布」 only through the PM-side checklist — os-dev.md carries the obligation line alone, as ruled for this card (403/403, one fold). A second dev-side line would need a second fold and is the seat's call, not this flight's.
- noted, not filed: the harness-injected commit/PR attribution form (a model-bearing `Co-Authored-By` trailer; a `🤖 Generated with` PR footer) differs from AGENTS.md's model-free trailer pair and session-URL footer; this PR uses the AGENTS.md forms.
- Changeset: none — `.claude/**` publishes nothing; `skip-changeset` applied via the additive labels endpoint with a comparison read-back.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **事情**:把您 09-05 裁的 E3 标准「已发布必修,其余立卡」和 09-07 批次 #64 裁定的三条边界写进 agent 语料:dev 端一行义务(os-dev.md),PM 复核清单三行——「已发布 = 各包 `files[]` 实际发运的内容」、`.js.map` 的 `sourcesContent` 不算、本轮只注意到未触碰的立卡不修。
- **为什么**:此前语料里一个字都没有(实测 grep 零命中),每轮由持卡人各自解读,量到「未发布」就静默放走。
- **风险**:零机制改动,四行文字、四处折行付账,所有钉住的行数不变;回滚即 revert 一个 commit。
- **席位意见**:(席位定稿时填)
- **要您做什么**:人工合并这张受管面 PR;或指出哪一行措辞与您的裁决不符。
